tags.name: update worker
tags.description: The WikiFact update worker, the background process that judges submitted claims with narrow model questions and writes accepted facts. Facts about its lock file, takeover, startup, and processing belong under it.

tags.name: WikiFact MCP
tags.description: The WikiFact MCP tool interface that agents call to read, submit, and correct facts in the wiki. Facts about its tool calls, responses, and errors belong under it.

tags.name: operator console
tags.description: The WikiFact operator console, which an operator uses to edit tags and facts directly. Facts about its edit actions, such as deleting a tag, belong under it.

tags.name: fact version
tags.description: One stored revision of a fact in the wiki, including its content, references, and the justification the submitter sent. Facts about how fact versions are stored and what they hold belong under it.

tags.name: consumer search
tags.description: The WikiFact consumer search, the read path that finds facts by similarity search for consumers. Facts about its vector source and how it reads the wiki belong under it.

tags.name: current_vec table
tags.description: The current_vec table in a wiki's SQLite database, which holds the embedding vectors that similarity search reads. Facts about its contents and which readers use it belong under it.

tags.name: request table
tags.description: The request table in a wiki's SQLite database, which holds submitted claims and their queued, failed, or repair rows for the update worker. Facts about its columns and the rows it holds belong under it.

tags.name: wiki
tags.description: A wiki: one folder under wikis/ that holds the wiki's wikifact.json file and its SQLite database file. Facts about a wiki's folder, files, and layout belong under it.

tags.name: embedding model
tags.description: The model that turns text into embedding vectors for similarity search in WikiFact. Facts about its default model name, vector dimension, and how it is configured belong under it.

tags.name: evals
tags.description: The eval code under the eval/ folder of the WikiFact code base. Facts about eval files, eval-only enums, and eval layout belong under it.

tags.name: fact confidence
